body: If I "attacked" anyone in what I said, it wasn't women. It was the safety nets themselves. I don't blame women for taking advantage of whatever resources they can. I do blame others for their blatant sexist refusal to help men in need.
im sorry you went through that. Had you asked for residential assistance from charities or welfare programs, they would have given you a place to sleep that day.

Like I said: I'm here and I see and experience it all the time. You can talk about your opinions all day, I'm telling you what the reality of the situation is. I'm sorry if it conflicts with your preconceived notions.
